banners.prompt:
Create a NEW, finished Facebook/Instagram feed advertising banner (tall portrait) for a Bulgarian audience, from scratch.
IMAGE 1 is only a blank grey canvas used for size: ignore its content completely and fill the whole frame with the banner. The whole frame is the banner - nothing will be cropped. Keep every text line, the book and the CTA button fully inside the frame with comfortable margins (at least 6% from every edge); the side areas near the left and right edges should be background only.

IMAGE 2 is the real book cover of the book "Думите, Които Продават". Reproduce it exactly on the physical book (printed paperback, slightly three-dimensional, natural shadow): same design, colours and all cover lettering letter by letter. Do not invent or change any cover text.

FORMAT: PAIN scene with a real person (style reference = IMAGE 3, our own banner for the same book: dark top band with big headline, photo scene below, red CTA pill at the bottom - follow its layout logic and typography, but a NEW scene and NEW text).
SCENE: a 38-year-old Bulgarian woman, dark-blond hair in a loose bun, cosy knitted sweater, sits at her home worktable in the evening with a few handmade soy candles in jars and wrapping paper. She stares at her smartphone with a disappointed, slightly frustrated expression. On the phone screen (clearly visible, angled to the viewer) a messenger chat: an incoming bubble "Колко струва?", her outgoing reply "18 €", and under it the small grey label "Видяно" with no answer. The book (IMAGE 2) lies small on the table at the lower right, cover visible, about 15% of the banner width.
TEXT ON THE BANNER (exactly these lines, nothing else):
1) Headline on a dark band at the top, white, two lines: "Клиентът пита "колко струва" … и изчезва?" - make the words "и изчезва?" yellow #F5C518.
2) Subheadline under the photo area, white on a dark bottom band: "Ето как да превърнем "cena" в поръчка" (keep the Latin word cena exactly as written).
3) CTA button: "ВИЖ КАК →"
TYPOGRAPHY RULES (critical):
- All text is Bulgarian Cyrillic. Render every text line EXACTLY as given, character by character, including punctuation, quotation marks and the Latin word where given. Do not translate, correct, shorten, re-order or add any words.
- Use a heavy, clean, condensed sans-serif for headlines (like Oswald Bold / Bebas-style weight but with full Cyrillic), unless the format below says otherwise.
- Text must be large and clearly legible on a phone at 380px width: headline lines at least ~6% of the banner height, subheadline ~3.5%, CTA text ~3.5%. Keep generous side margins (about 6% of the width).
- Strong contrast only: white or near-black text; accent words in warm yellow #F5C518; no grey text on dark backgrounds.
- CTA = rounded pill button in vivid red #E8232A with bold white uppercase text and an arrow →, centred near the bottom of the central area.
- No other text, logos, watermarks, prices of the book, percentages or website addresses anywhere.

PHOTO STYLE: realistic, natural-looking photo like a real Bulgarian everyday scene taken with a good phone camera; natural light, real skin texture; not glossy stock, no beauty filter. People have only two hands with five fingers each.
